title: PolyRoute: A Twelve-Language and Code-Mixed Benchmark for Typed-Decision Routing, with Baselines and a Leaderboard
abstract: arXiv:2611.13843v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Typed-decision encoders answer a question about a text in one forward pass, but their behaviour outside English is rarely measured on a fixed yardstick. We release PolyRoute: 322 native-language support messages in 12 languages and 9 writing systems, 156 code-mixed or romanised messages (Hinglish, Spanglish, Arabizi), 967 optional native training rows, and a protocol for a three-way department-routing decision. Labels come from Qwen3.8-27B with a blind second pass (91% of candidates kept); an independent model, gemma4-31b, agrees on 97.2% of test items, and the largest character 5-gram similarity between any test text and any training text is 0.33. A leaderboard of 13 systems gives 61.2% for the English-root checkpoint, 77.3% for the shipped multilingual one and 96.6% for the best fine-tune; TF-IDF with logistic regression reaches 91.9%. On four withheld languages the three multilingual systems score 77%, 90% and 93%. On code-mixed tex

translated_title: PolyRoute：一个面向类型化决策路由的十二语言与混码文本基准，附带基线与排行榜
translated_abstract: 类型化决策编码器可以在一次前向传播中回答关于文本的问题，但其在英语之外的表现很少在统一的评测标准下得到衡量。我们发布了PolyRoute基准：包含12种语言、9种书写系统的322条母语支持消息，156条混码或罗马化消息（印英混合语、西英混合语、阿拉伯罗马化文本），967条可选的母语训练数据行，以及一个三方部门路由决策的评测协议。标签由Qwen3.8-27B生成并经过盲审二次筛选（91%的候选被保留）；独立模型gemma4-31b在97.2%的测试项上与之一致，且任意测试文本与训练文本之间的最大字符5-gram相似度仅为0.33。13个系统的排行榜显示：英语根检查点得分为61.2%，官方发布的多语言版本为77.3%，最佳微调模型达到96.6%；TF-IDF结合逻辑回归达到91.9%。在四个未公开的语言上，三个多语言系统分别取得77%、90%和93%的成绩。在混码文本上……
tldr: 该论文发布了PolyRoute基准，涵盖12种语言、9种书写系统及混码文本的类型化决策路由评测，并提供13个系统的排行榜，显示微调模型可达96.6%准确率，且多语言模型对未公开语言具有良好的泛化能力。
